players.name: Joe Burrow
players.summary: Threw for 292 yards and four second-half touchdowns as Cincinnati erased a 13–0 halftime deficit to beat Baltimore 35–13 on October 25.

players.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
players.summary: Caught nine passes for 150 yards and a touchdown in Seattle's 20–3 Sunday-night win over previously unbeaten Kansas City.

players.name: Bo Nix
players.summary: Passed for 222 yards and a touchdown and rushed for 75 yards, including a 62-yard score, in Denver's 30–16 win at Arizona.

games.summary: AFC matchup in Buffalo; Baltimore seeks a rebound after allowing four second-half Joe Burrow touchdowns against Cincinnati.
AFC West rivalry after Kansas City's first loss in Seattle and Bo Nix's explosive rushing performance against Arizona.
Los Angeles rivals meet at SoFi Stadium in an intracity NFL showdown.
NFC East rivalry in Washington under the Sunday-night national spotlight.
The 5–2 Bears visit the 4–3 Seahawks at Lumen Field on Monday Night Football, after Chicago beat New England 30–24 and Seattle held Kansas City to three points.

setup: Chicago travels to Seattle at 5–2 after a 30–24 win over New England, while the 4–3 Seahawks just held previously unbeaten Kansas City to three points. Caleb Williams and the Bears bring a passing attack producing explosive plays, but Seattle's defense showed how effectively it can disrupt a top quarterback and keep opponents off the scoreboard.

things.title: Caleb Williams against Seattle’s defense
things.body: Williams threw for 308 yards and two touchdowns against New England, including several chunk gains to Chicago's receivers. Seattle held Patrick Mahomes to 165 passing yards and forced an interception against Kansas City. Protection and avoiding long-yardage downs are central to keeping Chicago's offense moving.

things.title: Containing Jaxon Smith-Njigba
things.body: Smith-Njigba caught nine passes for 150 yards and a touchdown against the Chiefs, taking his season totals to 867 receiving yards and eight scores. The Bears must decide how much coverage help to commit to Seattle's top target without creating room for Sam Darnold's other options.

things.title: Who controls the ground game?
things.body: Emanuel Wilson rushed for 100 yards and a touchdown in Seattle's win over Kansas City. Chicago got a rushing touchdown from D'Andre Swift against New England, but sustaining early-down gains on the road matters especially with Seattle's pass defense coming off a dominant outing.

breakdown.bottom_line: Seattle's defense and Smith-Njigba's explosive receiving challenge Chicago on both sides of the ball. The matchup turns on whether Williams can find consistent protection and explosive throws while the Bears keep Seattle balanced rather than letting its passing game dictate field position.
